text: Spec read in full; cross-checked against `src/App.tsx` (6 projects confirmed, Unsplash fallback URLs confirmed, `h-48 md:h-full` media box), `vite.config.ts`, and `public/` (exists; contains only the CV docx — no `screenshots/` yet). ## Findings **HIGH** 1. **Untestable baseline (FR-001, FR-002, FR-003, SC-001, SC-002)** — Every layout criterion is defined relative to a "pre-change baseline" / "visibly larger," but no baseline metrics are recorded anywhere, and this directory is not a git repo, so the baseline will be unrecoverable once changed. "Visibly larger" is subjective; "measurably larger" has no metric. Fix: record concrete numbers now (current: container `max-w-6xl`=1152px, media box `h-48`, hero `text-4xl/md:text-5xl`) and/or replace with numeric targets (e.g., container ≥1280px, media height ≥X px, type scale step-up per role). 2. **Silent base-path assumption (FR-004, FR-005, SC-003, SC-004)** — Root-absolute `/screenshots/.png` breaks when `base` is non-root: `vite.config.ts:14` sets `base` from `FIGMA_PUBLIC_URL` for Figma preview deployments. Under a prefixed base, every local screenshot 404s and FR-005's *silent* fallback masks it permanently (site ships stock photos with no signal). Spec must state the assumption (root base) or require base-aware paths (`import.meta.env.BASE_URL`). **MEDIUM** 3. **Unsatisfiable/ambiguous console clause (FR-005)** — "No console error surfacing to users" is confused: users never see consoles, and a runtime `` fallback cannot suppress the devtools network-404 entry for a missing file. As written the clause is unverifiable and secretly constrains implementation toward build-time existence checks. Reword to observable behavior: "no user-visible error UI, no unhandled exceptions." 4. **Slug rule undefined (FR-004, FR-006)** — `` has no derivation rule, and titles diverge sharply from repo names (e.g., "LDPlayer Automation Tool" → repo `laughing-octo-funicular`; "POS Accessories CLI System" → `POS_accessories_CLI`). Wrong-filename-silent-fallback is exactly the owner's core failure mode. Fix: pin the six exact filenames in the spec, or declare the FR-006 checklist doc the normative filename source with an explicit slug table. 5. **Mixed/partial state untested (SC-003, SC-004)** — Criteria cover all-absent and one-present states only. No criterion for the realistic steady state: some cards on screenshots, some on fallback, and independence (adding one file changes only its card). 6. **Corrupt file uncovered (FR-005, SC-004)** — Fallback triggers on *absence* only. A present-but-corrupt/mis-encoded file (SC-004 carefully says "valid PNG," implying invalid ones exist as a case) has no defined behavior; it should fall back identically. 7. **Format/case strictness unstated (FR-006)** — PNG-only? `.PNG` or `.jpg` on a case-sensitive deploy silently falls back. Checklist must state exact lowercase `.png`, sole accepted extension. 8. **Crop/aspect-ratio assumption (FR-003, FR-006)** — Media boxes fill-and-crop (`object-cover`); arbitrary screenshot aspect ratios will be center-cropped, potentially cutting off terminal text. FR-006's "recommended pixel dimensions" isn't tied to the actual rendered box ratio (~5:3 at 320px column). Require dimension guidance matching the final media-box aspect ratio, or an explicit acceptable-crop policy. 9. **Checklist artifact underspecified (FR-006, SC-005)** — "A checklist document SHALL exist" fixes no location, name, or format (repo root? `docs/`? markdown?). Unverifiable against a moving target. 10. **Mobile regression unaddressed (FR-001, FR-002, SC-001)** — SC-001 is desktop-only (≥1280px). Scaling up type/padding has no criterion preserving small-viewport usability (2-col stat grid, fixed `h-14` nav vs. taller hero padding). **LOW** 11. **HOW-encoding in SC-002** — "taller *fixed height*" prescribes mechanism over outcome; an aspect-ratio-based media area satisfying the intent would fail the letter of the criterion. 12. **Hardcoded "six" (SC-002, SC-005)** — Count baked into criteria; stale if a project is added. 13. **Fallback availability assumption (FR-005)** — Permanent reliance on remote Unsplash CDN URLs; offline/blocked contexts render empty media boxes. State the assumption. 14. **Scope tension (Scope Boundaries vs FR-004)** — "No project metadata beyond image path fields" likely collides with needing a per-project slug/screenshot key; clarify such a key is permitted. [REVIEWED] | task-unknown | CONCERNS | Spec draft solid on WHAT/WHY but 2 HIGH (unverifiable baseline, base-path assumption) + 8 MED gaps force revision VERDICT: NEEDS_REVISION
